g.text: A799 · Keep the customer invoice?
GitHub Releases agreed · invoice coverage proposed
C · Agreed: GitHub Releases
A799 · Design review
Store each original with its own Waitron release
Frozen venue bundle + expected facts
Git keeps their checksum index
R5 requires R1 and R4
Keep R2/R3 too; no pass implied
Design for a private repository
Use existing CI access; verify it before build
Proposed builder contract: fetch and check original fingerprints before running candidate code; keep download credentials out of that code. Missing or corrupt
required inputs fail the run. No other provider or paid service.
Owner chose GitHub Releases
D · Recommended: require an issued F1
A799 · Design review
Harbour issued a full customer invoice
Customer: Mara Soler
Recorded address: 18 Market Street
Before and after the upgrade
Compare the original issued customer snapshot
Keep A799 open until this is covered
If issuance is unavailable, retain the dependency
F1 means a full invoice naming the customer. Require one written by the frozen older product. An unpaid order with customer details is different. This choice enables
no F1 route and changes no fiscal code.
Proposed: mandatory before completion
D · Alternative: narrower first scope
A799 · Design review
An unpaid order plus an issued F2
Order: Mara Soler, 18 Market Street
Still unpaid; no issued customer invoice
F2: a simplified receipt
Does not cover an issued F1 customer snapshot
A799 may close with that gap explicit
Track issued-F1 preservation as a separate follow-up
This alternative accepts missing customer-invoice coverage in the first A799 delivery. A successful restart, upgrade or new sale cannot stand in for it. Neither option
approves capture or the full build.
Proposed: narrower completion
Static design drawings. R1–R5 and Harbour are imagined. No fixture or upgrade has run. A–C precise scope only; D, full design, plan and build await approval. A760 reset is separate.
Private access must be verified.
